name.description: Display name of the user who created this tax rate.

parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: effective_as_of
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date string to return the rate status effective on this date. Defaults to the current date if omitted.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: String ID of the tax rate whose status was requested. For NOT_FOUND statuses, this contains the ID that was not found.

status.description: Status of this tax rate relative to the effective_as_of date. One of: 'ACTIVE' (this rate is currently active), 'OUTDATED' (this rate was superseded by a newer rate — see current_rate_id for the replacement), 'NOT_FOUND' (the requested rate ID does not exist).

rate.description: The rate percentage value at the time of the query (e.g., '10.0' = 10%). Only present when status is 'ACTIVE' or 'OUTDATED'.

current_rate_id.description: String ID of the currently active tax rate that replaced this one. Only present when status is 'OUTDATED'. Pass to GET .../rates to fetch the replacement rate's details.

effective_start_date.description: ISO 8601 date string for when this tax rate becomes effective (e.g., '2024-01-01'). The rate applies to transactions on or after this date.

effective_end_date.description: ISO 8601 date string for when this tax rate expires. Null if this is the current active rate with no scheduled successor.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this rate record was created.

invoice_tax_application.description: Specifies how tax is applied on invoices. One of: 'NET' (tax calculated on the net/pre-tax amount), 'GROSS' (tax calculated on the gross/total amount), 'NONE' (used for group tax codes — the effective rate is the aggregate of its component codes' rates).

id.description: String ID of the user who created this tax rate. Use with the Users API to retrieve user details.

name.description: Display name of the user who created this tax rate.
